title: DALL-EVAL: Probing the Reasoning Skills and Social Biases of Text-to-Image Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using gender-neutral diagnostic prompts (e.g., professions) and using an automated vision-language model (BLIP-2) to classify the binary gender of the generated figures. The paper then computes the Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) of the resulting gender distribution against an unbiased uniform distribution.

Generating images from diagnostic text prompts, extracting facial landmarks (using FAN), and estimating facial albedo (using TRUST). The Individual Typology Angle (ITA) is calculated and mapped to the 10-point Monk Skin Tone (MST) scale, measuring how far the generated distribution deviates from a uniform distribution using MAD.
